newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba,Sandoz set news on Novartis.
newsitem.headline: Ciba,Sandoz set news on Novartis.

text.p: Swiss pharmaceutical groups Ciba-Geigy AG and Sandoz AG scheduled a news conference for 1500 GMT on Tuesday about their planned merger as the world's number two pharma firm, Novartis.
"We expect news on the merger of Ciba and Sandoz into Novartis during the course of the afternoon," the two companies said in a joint statemenmt.

No comment was immediately available from the two groups on whether the expected news was U.S. regulatory approval, which is the last major obstacle to concluding the merger as planned by the end of this year.
Spokesmen at Ciba and Sandoz said they could not elaborate any further before the news conference.
"We cannot say more now. We have to stick to this wording," a Ciba spokesman said about the announcement.
The merger of both companies to form the world's second-biggest pharmaceuticals concern was approved by each company's shareholders in April and by the European Commission in July.
Sandoz and Cibna said in late October they expected the FTC to rule in late autumn.
